Naoko Takei Moore

Founder of TOIRO, cookbook author, and the woman who brought authentic Iga-yaki donabe to American kitchens.

OUR STORY

TOIRO is the official US representative of Nagatani-en, the legendary maker of Iga-yaki donabe in Iga, Japan. Every pot is shaped and finished by hand, then checked one by one before it travels to our West Hollywood shop and on to your table. We started TOIRO to share the Japanese art of one-pot cooking: simple food, cooked slowly, in a pot that can last a lifetime.
